name: self-update-applies-next-session
claim: A convention recorded in one session is applied by a later session that never heard it, which is the whole point of writing it down.

sessions.prompt: New house rule: every Python module in our repositories starts with the comment line `# owner: platform-team` as its very first line, above the docstring. Write that down where it belongs so it survives this conversation.
Add a new module `normalise.py` here with a function `normalise_title(title)` that trims whitespace and collapses runs of spaces.
